metadata.start_time_basis: BLF header interpreted as UTC, consistent with python-can 4.6.1. Confirm absolute clock with the logger configuration; relative sample times are unchanged.
metadata.time_axis: Seconds relative to BLF header start time; original sample times; no resampling
metadata.numeric_values: Physical DBC values; enumerations kept numeric. Unscaled integers remain exact; nonidentity scale/offset uses float64 and may round large 64-bit values. Integers >15 decimal digits stored as text in XLSX.

compatibility: MDF 4.10 numeric channels, original timestamps. MDA 8.6 validation requires the target application.
storage_note: Only DBC-decoded data exported; retain original BLF for raw frames and unrecognized data.
